```javascript
 * Clamps a value to a given range [min, max].
 * @param {number} value - The original value to clamp.
 * @param {number} min  - The minimum bound of the range.
 * @param {number} max - The maximum bound of the range.
```

```rust
fn fibonacci(n: u64) -> u64 {
    // handle base cases
    let mut a = 0;
    let mut b = 1;
    if n == 0 {
        return a;
    }
    // We want the nth Fibonacci number, assuming F(0)=0, F(1)=1.
    // For n >= 1, we iterate n-1 times to get to F(n)
    let mut count = n - 1;
    loop {
        a = b;
        b = a + b;
        if count == 0 {
            return b;
        }
        count -= 1;
    }
}
```
